source_claim: water and thermal gradients drive streaming potential from ionic electrokinetics and ionic thermoelectric potential from Soret effect
source_intervention_evidence: The integration of ionic power generation with solar-driven water evaporation presents a promising solution to the critical global problems of freshwater scarcity and clean energy deficiency.
source_mechanism_evidence: The excellent ionic power generation is intimately related to the water and thermal gradients across the membrane, which not only induces fast water evaporation but also synergistically promotes the transport of counterions in charged nanochannels, and the corresponding mechanism is attributed to the streaming potential resulting from the ionic electrokinetic effect and the ionic thermoelectric potential originating from the Soret effect.
source_outcome_evidence: Under one sun illumination, the CC@PPy film can produce a sustained voltage output of similar to 0.7 V and a water evaporation rate up to 1.67 kg m(-2) h(-1) when an adequate water supply is available.
target_title: Water Evaporation-Enhanced Thermogalvanic Cell for Waste Steam Utilizing
target_material: water evaporation-enhanced thermogalvanic cell electrolyte
target_mechanism: ambient evaporation creates electrolyte concentration gradient and sub-ambient cold side, boosting thermopower and output from waste steam

source_title: Enhancing hydrovoltaic power generation through heat conduction effects
source_levers_cn: 湿度/蒸发梯度
source_claim: gelatin improves heat conduction and thermoelectric conversion while hydrovoltaic evaporation maintains temperature difference
source_intervention_evidence: Here we demonstrate a heat conduction effect enhanced hydrovoltaic power generator by integrating a flexible ionic thermoelectric gelatin material with a porous dual-size Al2O3 hydrovoltaic generator.
source_mechanism_evidence: In the hybrid heat conduction effect enhanced hydrovoltaic power generator, the ionic thermoelectric gelatin material can effectively improve the heat conduction between hydrovoltaic generator and near environment, thus increasing the water evaporation rate to improve the output voltage.
source_outcome_evidence: Moreover, the system can efficiently achieve solar-to-thermal conversion to raise the temperature difference, accompanied by a stable open circuit voltage of 6.4 V for the hydrovoltaic generator module, the highest value yet.
